title: fix(mobile): Clean up action buttons, layout, and remove duplicate sidebar toggle
body:
Mobile detail page has three issues: duplicate sidebar toggle buttons (AppShell + AppHeader both render `SidebarTrigger`), action button clutter pushing content down, and single-column field layout wasting horizontal space. ### Duplicate sidebar toggle - `AppShell.tsx`: Add `hidden md:inline-flex` to `SidebarTrigger` and its adjacent divider — AppHeader already renders its own mobile-only trigger (`md:hidden`) ### Action button overflow on mobile - `action-bar.tsx`: Use `useIsMobile()` to reduce inline actions to 1 on mobile (vs 3 on desktop), rest go to overflow menu. New `mobileMaxVisible` schema prop for per-instance control. - `DetailView.tsx`: Hide Share, Edit, Inline Edit buttons on mobile (`hidden sm:inline-flex`), mirror them as `sm:hidden` items in the More Actions dropdown. ```tsx // action-bar now adapts maxVisible to viewport const maxVisible = isMobile ? (schema.mobileMaxVisible ?? 1) : (schema.maxVisible ?? 3); ``` ### Detail field grid - `DetailSection.tsx`: Use responsive Tailwind breakpoints for grid columns instead of hardcoding. Changed from `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2` → `grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2`, lowering the 2-column threshold from `md` (768px) to `sm` (640px) so more mobile devices get multi-column layout while narrow screens gracefully fall back to 1 column. Progressive breakpoints: 1 col → `sm:` 2 cols → `lg:` 3 cols.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > [Mobile UI] Clean Up Action Buttons, Layout, and Remove Duplicate Sidebar Toggle Button > ### 问题概述 > 移动端订单详情页存在以下主要问题： > > 1. **Action Buttons Clutter（操作按钮堆叠）** > - 顶部显示多个主要操作按钮（如“Change Status”、“Generate Invoice”、“Mark as Shipped”等），导致页面内容区域被挤压、操作区显得拥挤。 > - 建议：仅保留最重要的主操作按钮，其他操作放入“...”（更多）菜单内。 > > 2. **Layout & Spacing（布局与间距）** > - 详情区字段排版竖直过长，没有充分利用屏幕宽度。 > - 建议：使用网格布局优化字段展示，提升移动端空间利用率。 > > 3. **顶部折叠侧边栏按钮出现两次** > - 顶部（Header）区域重复显示了两个侧边栏折叠按钮，影响视觉简洁性，也容易让用户混淆。 > - 建议：仅保留一个全局的折叠按钮，删除页面内的冗余按钮，并共享状态。 > > ### 参考截图 > > > ### 优化建议汇总 > - 保留单一主操作按钮，其他操作合并进下拉菜单，简化头部区域。 > - 采用2列网格优化详情字段排版，保持整体风格一致。 > - 只显示一个侧边栏折叠切换按钮，避免按钮重复，统一状态。 > > ### 期望结果 > - 页面更加简洁、操作顺畅、移动端显示更美观。 > - Header区域只有一个折叠按钮，所有操作一目了然。 > > --- > 如需详细设计方案，可随时补充！ > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
